discrimination_rule.frontier_reference: best MRR/R@1 among pse_current_reconstruction, pse_candidate_v1, pse_candidate_v2
discrimination_rule.sufficient_if: Both random and recency trail the best PSE result by at least 0.15 absolute MRR and at least 0.15 absolute Recall@1.

a_mem_next_step_rule.if_discrimination_sufficient: Run exact-pinned A-MEM on a scope frozen before A-MEM v4 results; full 24 cases preferred if zero-cost compute remains feasible.
a_mem_next_step_rule.if_discrimination_insufficient: Do not spend additional A-MEM compute merely to rank frontier systems on this benchmark; record benchmark-design failure and keep Gate E incomplete.

claim_boundary: Post-candidate-freeze development benchmark-discrimination evidence only; not parity, superiority, equivalence, non-inferiority, SOTA, sealed-final, or independent-reproduction evidence.
